gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests for {@link Tag#valueOf(String)} and related lookups, focusing on how tag names are resolved (case handling) and validated (rejecting blank names).
ADDED i2: Tag name lookup is case-insensitive: resolving the same tag in different letter cases yields equivalent tags, regardless of the active locale.
ADDED i3: The static lookup treats "script" and "SCRIPT" as the same tag (by equality).
ADDED i4: Looking up via a shared TagSet returns the very same cached Tag instance.
ADDED i5: A blank tag name (here a single space) is invalid and must be rejected.
